selection_reason: Highest initial combination of industrial sales value, fast demonstrability, measurable customer outcome, and clear delivery evidence.

active_lane_contract.value_hypothesis: زيادة وتحسين التقاط طلبات عروض الأسعار والاستفسارات الصناعية وتحويلها إلى مسار متابعة قابل للقياس.
delivery_units: demo scenario using clearly labeled synthetic data
acceptance_gate: all primary flows pass smoke tests
mobile and desktop behavior is checked
Arabic and English paths are checked
admin tracking is traceable to source inquiry
no fabricated customer or financial data is presented as real

measurement_loop.rule: Do not optimize vanity metrics when the next commercial gate is blocked.

pivot_thresholds.build_blocked: repair first blocking technical cause within bounded retries
pivot_thresholds.no_interest: revise targeting/value proposition before adding features
pivot_thresholds.acceptance_blocked: identify customer objection and revise offer
pivot_thresholds.payment_blocked: surface exact permitted payment action; never infer payment
